name: ORACLE
description: Guides the chapter and helps officers align plans and activities with university policies and student development goals.

name: APEX
description: Leads the chapter, coordinates its officers, and represents the interests of Computer Engineering students.

name: CORE
description: Coordinates internal operations and supports communication and cooperation among officers, committees, and members.

name: FLUX
description: Assists the Internal Vice President with internal coordination, member concerns, and follow-through on chapter plans.

name: RANGE
description: Coordinates connections with other chapters, partner organizations, and external collaborators.

name: TRACE
description: Maintains meeting minutes, correspondence, and organizational records so decisions and commitments are documented.

name: VAULT
description: Maintains financial records and supports budgeting, collections, and disbursements under the chapter’s approved procedures.

name: SCOPE
description: Reviews financial records and supporting documents to help maintain accuracy, transparency, and accountability.

name: IGNITE
description: Coordinates event planning, schedules, logistics, and collaboration among the teams delivering chapter programs.

name: IGNITE-1
description: Assists the Event Manager with event preparations, logistics, and assigned responsibilities during chapter programs.

name: IGNITE-2
description: Assists the Event Manager with event preparations, logistics, and assigned responsibilities during chapter programs.

name: PULSE
description: Coordinates public announcements and communications to keep members and the wider community informed.

name: ECHO
description: Supports the Public Relations Officer in preparing announcements, sharing updates, and coordinating communications.

name: ROOKIE
description: Represents 1st year students, communicates their concerns to the officers, and shares chapter updates and opportunities with the batch.

name: DRIFT
description: Represents 2nd year students, communicates their concerns to the officers, and shares chapter updates and opportunities with the batch.

name: EDGE
description: Represents 3rd year students, communicates their concerns to the officers, and shares chapter updates and opportunities with the batch.

name: RELIC
description: Represents 4th year students, communicates their concerns to the officers, and shares chapter updates and opportunities with the batch.

name: PRISM
description: Develops visual materials and creative content that express the chapter’s identity and support its programs.

name: ANCHOR
description: Supports membership records, onboarding, and engagement to help students stay connected to the chapter.
